messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Telugu, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | Nel | “in the middle of” – locative phrase introducing position | Use post‑position **‑లో** attached to the following noun phrase (locative case). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “in”. | | mezzo | The exact middle point of a journey | Render as noun **మధ్య** with locative **‑లో** (మధ్యలో). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “middle”. | | del | Genitive linking *cammin* to *vita* | Attach genitive marker **‑యొక్క** to the head noun (e.g., **దారి యొక్క**). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “of”. | | cammin | The path or journey being travelled | Use noun **దారి** (road) in the appropriate case (genitive when required). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “road”. | | di | Genitive linking *nostra* to *vita* | Attach genitive **‑యొక్క** to the possessed noun (e.g., **మన జీవితం యొక్క**). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “of”. | | nostra | Possessive adjective indicating ownership by speaker and companions | Use possessive **మన** (our) agreeing in gender/number with the noun. *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “our”. | | vita | The span of existence of the speaker and companions | Use noun **జీవితం** (life). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “life”. | | mi | Reflexive clitic indicating the experiencer of the action | Use reflexive pronoun **నన్ను** (myself) as object of the verb. *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “myself”. | | ritrovai | “I found myself” – self‑locating action, past remote | Use past‑tense first‑person singular verb **కనుగొన్నాను** (found). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “found”. | | per | Preposition introducing the spatial domain of the finding | Use locative post‑position **‑లో** after the noun phrase (e.g., **అడవిలో**). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “in”. | | una | Indefinite article marking the noun as non‑specific | Telugu does not mark indefiniteness; omit article. *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “a”. | | selva | A forest, the dark environment | Use noun **అడవి** (forest). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “forest”. | | oscura | Qualifies *selva* as lacking light | Use adjective **చీకటి** (dark) agreeing with the noun (చీకటి అడవి). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “dark”. | | ché | Conjunction introducing a causal clause | Use conjunction **ఎందుకంటే** (because). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “because”. | | la | Definite article specifying the particular *via* | Omit article; Telugu relies on context. *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “the”. | | diritta | Describes *via* as the correct/straight one | Use adjective **సరైన** (right/correct) agreeing with the noun (సరైన దారి). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “right”. | | via | The correct path that should be followed | Use noun **దారి** (way). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “way”. | | era | Copular verb indicating a past state (imperfect) | Use imperfect past form **ఉంది** (was). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “was”. | | smarrita | State of being lost; the way is not found | Use past‑participle adjective **కోల్పోయింది** (lost). *Comparative/degree:* none. **Back‑translation:** “lost”. |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 1: మన జీవితం యొక్క దారి మధ్యలో / మన జీవితం దారి మధ్యలో / మన జీవితం దారి మధ్య భాగంలో - Line 2: నేను చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను / నేను చీకటి అడవిలో కనుగొన్నాను / నేను నా తాను చీకటి అడవిలో కనుగొన్నాను - Line 3: ఎందుకంటే సరైన దారి కోల్పోయింది / ఎందుకంటే సరైన మార్గం కోల్పోయింది / ఎందుకంటే సరైన దారి లేదు

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Telugu lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
**Line Inventory:** - మన జీవితం యొక్క దారి మధ్యలో
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase already contains the genitive marker **యొక్క** and the locative **మధ్యలో**.
**Target Text:** మన జీవితం యొక్క దారి మధ్యలో
---
**Source Line:** mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,
**Line Inventory:** - నేను చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను
**Assembly Notes:** - Inserted the comma that appears at the end of the source line.
**Target Text:** నేను చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను,
---
**Source Line:** ché la diritta via era smarrita.
**Line Inventory:** - ఎందుకంటే సరైన దారి కోల్పోయింది
**Assembly Notes:** - Inserted the period that appears at the end of the source line.
**Target Text:** ఎందుకంటే సరైన దారి కోల్పోయింది.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1 Target Text: మన జీవితం యొక్క దారి మధ్యలో Back-Translation: “in the middle of the road of our life” Reference Translation: Midway upon the road of our life Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> Corrected Target Text:
- Line 2 Target Text: నేను చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను, Back-Translation: “I found myself in a dark forest” Reference Translation: I found myself within a dark wood, Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> Corrected Target Text:
- Line 3 Target Text: ఎందుకంటే సరైన దారి కోల్పోయింది. Back-Translation: “because the right way was lost” Reference Translation: for the right way had been missed. Checks: End Punct <OK>, Coverage <OK>, Meaning Drift <OK>, Comparative Orientation <N/A>, Hallucination <OK> Corrected Target Text:
``` మన జీవితం యొక్క దారి మధ్యలో నేను చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను, ఎందుకంటే సరైన దారి కోల్పోయింది. ```
